name: Errol
description: Sends one question from Errol Hulse's A Catechism for Boys and Girls at 7:15am and again at 5:15pm, repeating the same item both times with its answer. Built for households drilling catechism by repetition, and tied to that specific text rather than any catechism you choose.

official.title: Errol by Zach
official.description: Twice-daily drill from A Catechism for Boys and Girls (Errol Hulse, Chapel Library). Sends the same question at 7:15am and 5:15pm with the catechism...
